ops.title: UserPromptSubmit signal scan sees only the user prompt — assistant walls of text never trip the gate
ops.description: transcript_texts(evt) returns [evt.user_prompt] for UserPromptSubmit, so a nudge like show's wall_of_text cannot fire on the canonical 'agent dumps options as prose, user replies hmm' sequence — the wall lives in the prior ASSISTANT turn, which the signal pre-filter never scans. Coverage today rides entirely on PostToolUse. Plan: include a bounded window of recent assistant-turn text in the UserPromptSubmit scan source (respecting Signals window semantics), add harness cases pinning the option-dump-then-neutral-reply sequence, and verify the cc-context (381) and cc-notes (238) suites stay green — thresholds were tuned against the old scan source, so audit packs whose UPS hooks could newly fire.

ops.text: harness test: an option-dump assistant turn followed by a neutral user prompt passes the show pack's signal gate on UserPromptSubmit
cc-context and cc-notes hook suites green under the new scan source
